comments: Alternative fit to Saha et al. photometry using 17 high-quality Cepheids on chips 1, 3 and 4. Chip 2 was excluded because its modulus was 0.66 mag larger; including it would give mu0=31.03+/-0.11.

Final ALLFRAME+TRIAL solution. The PL fit uses 27 of 39 candidates with P>20 d to limit incompleteness. All four WFPC2 chips are included because this reduction shows no significant chip-dependent offset.
There are no specific comments on the publication. Cepheid moduli are compiled and homogenized from earlier HST Key Project and independent studies. Previous author included it.

PC-only true modulus from six Cepheids, derived for the differential blending test. It is a chip-specific PL result rather than an adopted global galaxy distance. The quoted uncertainty is internal; no separate systematic term is provided.
WFC-only true modulus from 21 Cepheids. Its offset from the PC result is -0.035+/-0.167 mag, inconsistent with the +0.11 mag shift predicted by severe blending. No metallicity correction was applied.
Uncorrected re-fit of 27 previously selected Cepheids using the Stetson WFPC2 zero point, Udalski OGLE-LMC PL relations and mu_LMC=18.45. Only the internal random R_PL uncertainty is tabulated.

Sandage/Saha HST observations reanalyzed by the Key Project are used. The fit solves simultaneously for distance and reddening. The quoted error is random; the dominant common LMC systematic is omitted.
Final period-cut Wesenheit fit before abundance correction. e_R is the random PL-fit error only; N_cef is the post-cut sample.
Preferred near-solar-metallicity solution. Vlim variations shift mu by +0.18/-0.12 mag. The 153 Table 6 entries represent sosie matches, not a verified distinct-Cepheid count.
Bias-corrected HIPPARCOS PL solution. Incompleteness is important in the raw sample, although the limiting-magnitude stability test around the final fit is small.
Representative LMC mean-light solution. Includes the +0.05 mag STS CTE correction; random error only.
Maximum-light LMC PL solution used as a consistency test. CTE corrected without metallicity correction.
Representative FSG03 Galactic mean-light solution. CTE corrected but not metallicity corrected.
Re-fit of published Gibson et al. (2000) WFPC2 photometry using the OGLE+10 PL relations. The number of retained Cepheids is not stated clearly; the +0.08 mag metallicity correction is not applied.
